title: 第五章 姑姑的杀心，️有鱼上钩了
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
一位穿着精致，身材高挑的年轻女孩提着裙子，从人群后面冲了出来，径直奔向傅烬川，他身后的保镖看见来人有些犹豫。

    黎欣贴过来，顺势挽上他的右臂。

    伤处猝不及防被碰到，傅烬川脸色一沉，猛地转头怒视来人，眼神冷得吓人。

    现在真是什么女人都能随便碰自己，身边的保镖又该换了。

    抬手攥住黎欣手腕，傅烬川毫不客气地一把甩开，“谁让你过来的。”

    声音冷得没有一丝温度，看向黎欣的眼神中丝毫没有掩饰内心的厌恶。

    就说女人很讨厌，这个尤其让人生厌。

    不远处，傅晚棠慢悠悠走了过来。

    有了刚才黎欣的事情，保镖们感受到傅烬川无意间扫来的眼神，汗毛倒竖，没敢再放傅晚棠过去，纷纷挡在他身后。

    “小川这么大阵仗，连姑姑都防得这么紧呐？”

    傅晚棠笑了笑，双手环胸站在人墙外直视着傅烬川。

    眼神若有似无地瞟了眼黎欣，见她悄悄点头，才又开口：

    “我听说这块地邪门得很，自杀的人一个接一个，晦气得要命，开发这里你可要想清楚了。

    “董事会那些老家伙没有省油的灯，他们要拿这个做文章，我可帮不了你。”

    “我做长辈的想过来帮你参考参考，既然你不领情那就算了。”

    “黎欣，走了。”

    “是，母亲。”黎欣怯怯地看了眼傅烬川，快步退了回去。

    张玉水和庄西对视一眼，非常默契地后退几步，闭眼闭耳，隐于人后，只当自己是个透明人。

    傅烬川自始至终都冷着脸，没有多发一言，他心里很清楚，姑姑根本没安好心。

    以前父母在世时，傅晚棠一向温柔恭谨，对他千依百顺。

    父母一死，祖父昏迷不醒，她仗着长辈身份在董事会处处夺权掣肘，想要扳倒他。

    至于黎欣，不过就是她的养女，整天替她做些上不得台面的勾当。
content_en:
A well-dressed, tall young girl held up her skirt and rushed out from behind the crowd, running straight towards Fu Jinchuan. The bodyguard behind him hesitated when he saw the person coming.

    Li Xin came over and took advantage of his right arm.

    The injured area was touched unexpectedly. Fu Jinchuan's face darkened, and he suddenly turned his head and glared at the person coming, his eyes were frighteningly cold.

    Now it is true that any woman can touch him casually, and it is time to change the bodyguards around him.

    Raising his hand to grab Li Xin's wrist, Fu Jinchuan shook it off without ceremony, "Who asked you to come here?"

    The voice was cold without any warmth, and the look in Li Xin's eyes did not hide the disgust in his heart.

    Let’s just say women are annoying, and this one is especially annoying.

    Not far away, Fu Wantang walked over slowly.

    After what happened to Li Xin just now, the bodyguards felt Fu Jinchuan's unintentional glances, and their hair stood on end. They did not dare to let Fu Wantang pass and blocked him one after another.

    "Xiao Chuan is so big, even my aunt is on such tight guard?"

    Fu Wantang smiled, stood outside the human wall with his arms folded, and looked directly at Fu Jinchuan.

    He glanced at Li Xin with a vague look in his eyes, and when he saw her nodding quietly, he spoke again:

    "I heard that this land is very evil. People commit suicide one after another. It's extremely unlucky. You have to think carefully when developing this place.

    "The old guys on the board of directors don't have a fuel-efficient lamp. They want to make a fuss about this, and I can't help you. "

    "As an elder, I want to come over and help you with reference. Since you don't appreciate it, forget it. "

    "Li Xin, let's go. "

    "Yes, mother. "Li Xin glanced at Fu Jinchuan timidly and quickly stepped back.

    Zhang Yushui and Zhuang west looked at each other, took a few steps back in tacit understanding, closed their eyes and ears, and hid themselves behind others, just pretending to be transparent people.

    Fu Jinchuan kept a cold face from beginning to end and didn't say a word. He knew very well that his aunt had no good intentions at all.

    When his parents were still alive, Fu Wantang had always been gentle, respectful and obedient to him.

    After her parents died and her grandfather fell into a coma, she relied on her status as the elder to seize power in the board of directors and try to overthrow him.

    As for Li Xin, she is just her adopted daughter, doing shady things for her all day long.
title_en: Chapter 5: My aunt’s murderous intention, ️ a fish has taken the bait
